obligations.claim: Eight-regularity, nonnegative symmetric actual defect of row sum four, all actual blocks and commutation.

The spectral bound is valid for weighted B_i. The optional T-connectivity argument gives a Rayleigh quotient at least 13 against the upper bound 4.

obligations.claim: Every R cycle length is divisible by four and at least five cycles occur; the four displayed types exhaust all cases.
obligations.evidence: S+3I is invertible and sends 1 to 4 times 1. On the five-dimensional matching contrast space, ||X^T v||^2 >= ||v||^2. Its image lies in the -2 eigenspace of R, with one dimension per even cycle. Partitions of seven into at least five positive parts are exactly 3+1+1+1+1, 2+2+1+1+1, 2+1+1+1+1+1, and seven ones.

obligations.evidence: Summing the finite recurrence gives sum (g_z+g_(z+1))^2=0. Nonnegative integral h alternates 0 and 1. The difference recurrence d_(z+2)=-d_z makes each matching row select one residue and its mate the opposite residue.

obligations.claim: The compression factor is k_l/2 and every cycle of length at least twelve is excluded.
obligations.evidence: Each projected parity vector p/sqrt(2) or (1-p)/sqrt(2) occurs 2k_l times, yielding (k_l/2)(J+epsilon_l epsilon_l^T). On 1-perp the Rayleigh upper bound is 9. Balanced signs have squared mutual inner product at least 4, giving (8k+7)/3, which exceeds 9 for k>=3. The supplementary total-weight-at-most-two observation follows by grouping equal signs up to sign.

obligations.claim: Every C8 component is impossible, including both remaining C8-containing types.
obligations.evidence: Rows of Z have size at most 2; only distance-three pairs survive the closed-neighborhood and XY^T restrictions. The exact B_88 block is 2P4+W with w_z=h_z-1>=0. The (z,z+2) commutator entry is w_(z-1)=w_z. Each step-three unordered pair is represented once, so n_2=8h; 24 incidences force (n_0,n_1,n_2)=(5,8,8). Every zero row has four size-two neighbors; every size-two row has exactly two zero-row neighbors. These count the same undirected T edges as 20 and 16.

Each block row sum is 0 or 1. Its support has size 12 and complement size 9; the complement is independent. Every vertex receives a three-element label, and the four neighbor labels exhaust the four triples disjoint from its label. The image is therefore nonempty and neighbor-closed in connected KG(7,3). The supplied two-step paths via complements of four-element unions establish connectivity. Surjectivity onto 35 labels contradicts the domain size 21, without assuming distinct labels or connected T.
